title: Which value must IVT attain?
statement:
A continuous function on $[0,1]$ has $f(0)=-[$a]$ and $f(1)=[$a]+1$. Enter the midpoint of the two endpoint outputs, which IVT guarantees is attained.

[__________]{a}
hints: Add the two signed endpoint values.
The result is between the endpoint outputs.
solution: Their average is $(-[$a]+[$a]+1)/2=1/2$, so IVT guarantees it is attained.

feedback.message: The result is between the endpoint outputs.
